newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON MARCH 18.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-RADIO HEADLINES AT NOON MARCH 18.

text.p: Lithuania's M1 Plus radio reported the following stories on their noon programme on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two thousand Lithuanian soldiers are taking part in a special spring training exercise. .

- The interior ministers of Lithuania and Finland are expected to sign a co-operation agreement on crime prevention and readmission of illegal imigrants in Vilnius today. The latter is a requirement for a visa-free regime between the states.
